title: 7 Flavor-Packed Compound Butter Recipes
summary: All it takes are a few additions to creamy butter to create something worthy of any dinner party
body_markdown:
Looking to elevate a meal with minimal effort? A flavorful compound butter is just the ticket. All it takes are a few additions such as fresh herbs, flavorful citrus zests, or punchy flavor notes swirled into creamy butter to create something worthy of any dinner party. Here are 7 ways to make butter the star of the table.


## [Caramelized Onion, Rosemary and Thyme Compound Butter](https://vitalfarms.com/caramelized-onion-rosemary-and-thyme-compound-butter/)


A delicious way to finish grilled steaks, sautéed mushrooms, and creamy mashed potatoes. Or, simply slather it onto toasty bread.


## [Maple Bacon Compound Butter](https://vitalfarms.com/maple-bacon-compound-butter/)


Simplify your breakfast toppings with this sweet and savory compound butter. Try it atop your morning pancakes, French toast and waffles. Your tastebuds will thank you.


## [Cheddar Chive Compound Butter](https://vitalfarms.com/cheddar-chive-compound-butter/)


Try this cheesy spread on your buttery biscuits or cornbread. Better yet, dollop this delicious butter into a just-opened, steamy baked potato.


## [Chipotle Cilantro Compound Butter](https://vitalfarms.com/chipotle-cilantro-compound-butter/)


Add this smoky, herbaceous butter to grilled steaks or sweet summer corn.


## [Caper Lemon Dill Compound Butter](https://vitalfarms.com/caper-lemon-dill-compound-butter/)


A bright, tangy and herbaceous butter—delightful when served over slow-roasted salmon or crisp green beans.


## [Garlic and Herbes De Provence Compound Butter](https://vitalfarms.com/garlic-and-herbes-de-provence-compound-butter/)


A fragrant addition to grilled steaks, roast chicken, or mashed potatoes with flavors of savory garlic and a blend of French herbs.


## [Cranberry Sage Compound BUtter](https://vitalfarms.com/cranberry-sage-compound-butter/)


A butter worthy of your holiday table. Spread it on toasted baguettes, fluffy fresh rolls or even on roast turkey or chicken.
